items.title: US charges ex-Robinhood engineers over alleged pre-listing crypto trades
items.snippet: The former employees allegedly earned more than $50,000 each by trading Hyperliquid perpetuals ahead of Robinhood token listings.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Crypto longs worth $570 million wiped out as Clarity Act fails
items.snippet: Bullish crypto futures bets worth millions have been liquidated in 24 hours. Bitcoin and ether longs have taken in the most losses.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC, ETH -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June
items.snippet: The $450 million withdrawal came as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate, with Fidelity and BlackRock funds leading the outflows.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: XRP sinks 10% as the Clarity Act fails and bitcoin slides toward $76,000
items.snippet: The Senate's 49-50 procedural vote left the crypto market structure bill 11 short of what it needed, and every major token fell.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC, XRP -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Crypto industry turns to US regulators after CLARITY setback
items.snippet: The CLARITY Act still has a procedural path after Senator Thom Tillis moved to reconsider the failed cloture vote, though industry executives are divided over whether Congress has enough time left.
